welcomeDescription: Configure your API endpoint and brand settings to start analyzing customer feedback.

home.flowHint: Four steps, mirrored by the sections in the sidebar.
home.intro: Turn scattered customer feedback into product decisions. Bring feedback in from any source, let AI surface the themes, shape the findings into personas and specs, then validate and prioritize what to build next.
home.phase1Desc: Pull in customer feedback with web scrapers or embeddable forms, then browse the raw and processed records.
home.phase2Desc: See what customers are telling you — sentiment, categories, and the biggest problems surfaced automatically.
home.phase3Desc: Ask questions in plain language, then spin findings into research projects with personas, PRDs, and PR/FAQs.
home.phase4Desc: Confirm demand with targeted feedback forms, then rank what to build by frequency, severity, and reach.
home.title: Welcome to Voice of the Customer
home.categoriesDesc: Categories decide how every review is classified. Map each one to the product it belongs to and the product owner responsible for it — owners automatically see their categories' feedback and are the people who act on it.
home.categoriesAskAdmin: An administrator sets these up in Settings → Categories.

buddy.title: Your setup checklist
buddy.readyDesc: Everything is set up. Hide the checklist for now, or turn it off. You can bring it back from your Account page.
buddy.saveFailed: Couldn't save your choice. Try again.
buddy.startOnDashboard: Open the dashboard when I sign in
buddy.sourceDesc: Set up a web scraper or a feedback form so customer feedback starts flowing in.
buddy.feedbackDesc: Once feedback arrives it is classified, scored for sentiment and urgency, and ready to explore.
buddy.assistantDesc: Ask a question about your feedback in plain language: trends, top complaints, what changed.
buddy.projectDesc: Turn findings into personas, PRDs and PR/FAQs in a project of your own.
